description: Checks an existing e-invoice PDF (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X), issued or received. Returns { isEInvoice, profile, invoice, totals, findings }: whether the PDF carries invoice XML in an EN 16931 profile, the data read from that XML, the totals calculated from its lines, and findings on missing data, arithmetic, PDF/A-3 and values of the XML that the text of the PDF does not show ("not-in-pdf"). A plausibility check, not a full EN 16931 Schematron or PDF/A validation.
name: validate_einvoice
title: Check an existing e-invoice
